name: orchestration
input_contract: Any new user request unless it explicitly opts out; Sol keeps high-value judgment, delegates exact evidence questions, and sends each decision-complete coherent repository write phase in a native V2 packet.
output_contract: A Sol-owned decision and acceptance response, optionally backed by a bounded Luna handoff with status, changed files, decisive evidence, gaps, and risk; browser/runtime QA defaults to the durable Chrome route.
rollback_boundary: Revert only this skill package's files; do not mutate child worktrees, external services, or user roles.
